name: Banishing Light
description: When this enchantment enters the battlefield, exile target permanent until this enchantment leaves the battlefield.
assumptions: Worded the trigger as "this enchantment" rather than a bare pronoun, since the self registry's type line is Enchantment.
couldNotDerive: Whether the targeted permanent is restricted to nonland or to an opponent's permanents (attempt 1, pre-fix).
Rarity, supertype/subtype, additional abilities beyond the ETB effect.
notes: Attempt 1 (pre-fix) missed both the `.nonLand` qualifier and the `.OppCtrl` owner on the real ValidTgts$ Permanent.nonLand+OppCtrl, reconstructing an unrestricted "target permanent" instead of "target nonland permanent an opponent controls." Root cause found: two real bugs. (1) qualifierFlags()/ownerFromTargetPredicate() both only matched a qualifier immediately after the FIRST dot (`\.OppCtrl\b`) — Forge chains qualifiers past the first with `+`, not another `.` (`Permanent.nonLand+OppCtrl`), so `.OppCtrl` here was never seen by the owner regex at all. Fixed by widening both regexes to `[.+]OppCtrl\b` etc. (2) Separately, the ChangeZone targeted-move handler had `qualifierFlags` extended with `.nonLand` support but never actually called qualifierFlags() on ValidTgts$ at all when building the move node's flags — wired that in. Re-verified directly against the regenerated packet (not a 3rd live exam run, to conserve budget): node now shows `owner:"opp"` and `flags:"target cond:until_self_leaves cond:nonland"`, an exact match to the real oracle text's "exile target nonland permanent an opponent controls until Banishing Light leaves the battlefield." Not re-run through a fresh blind agent a 3rd time since the fix is mechanically confirmed in the raw node data.
